done_when: forge read rewrites every path under the checkout in the reader's output to a repo-root path (/docs/..., which GitHub resolves from the repo root), before writing the notes, for both readers; a test feeds a stub reader an absolute path and finds only the repo-root path in the notes

findings.body: Native Windows citations remain machine-specific. For a checkout at `C:\work\repo`, this matches only `C:\work\repo/`, so neither `C:\work\repo\docs\a.md` nor `C:/work/repo/docs/a.md` becomes `/docs/a.md`. Windows is explicitly supported and runs this suite in `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:22`. The added test inputs at `tests/test_codex_reader.py:91` and `:131` append literal forward slashes to the checkout string, masking this failure on Windows. Handle native and forward-slash Windows paths and feed those forms through the stub-reader test.
